raeume.beschreibung: Long vaulted stone hall in dim, warm light. A dark wooden buffet counter stands opposite the entrance. A large tea kettle and a coffee machine stand on it. A sideboard stands against the north wall behind the counter. Buffet tables line both long walls. A sink and an ice bucket stand in the hall. An emergency exit sign is mounted on the wall. Stone floor.

Small, cool room without windows behind the buffet counter. Shelves line the walls. A birthday cake sits on the shelves. An emergency lantern hangs from a hook. The only way in is the door beside the sideboard. Stone floor.
Short, low passage between the west hall and the buffet hall. Stacked crates stand here. Stone floor.

Communal hall with two long tables and benches along the walls. A cold, unlit fireplace niche is set into the west wall. Two light shafts with flaps sit high in the north wall. A fuse box is mounted on the wall. In the northwest corner, a carved arched door leads to the tower passage. Stone floor.

Narrow passage at the foot of the castle tower. An old knight's armour stands here, next to a display case. A spiral staircase leads up to the toilets. The rest of the tower is locked with a padlock. A courtyard door is locked too. Stone floor.

Quiet communal hall with no other outside door. A coat rack stands at the entrance. A large wall board hangs on the east wall. Long tables and benches fill the room. A basket for phones stands here. Stone floor.
Small lobby between the inner door of the buffet hall and the outer gate. Stone floor.
